# Baudelaire

> Baudelaire is a Typst-native static site generator: write pages in Typst, get incremental builds, clean URLs, taxonomies, pagination, feeds, search, and an asset pipeline.

- [Install](https://baudelaire.dev/guide/install/)

- [CLI reference](https://baudelaire.dev/guide/cli/)
- [Deploying](https://baudelaire.dev/guide/deploy/)
- [Syntax highlighting](https://baudelaire.dev/guide/highlighting/)
